snippet.title: [TOUGEN ANKI Crimson Inferno] Official Game Cinematic Trailer | Meet the game at TGS 2025
snippet.description:
A fierce battle between the students of Rasetsu Academy and the Momotaro clan!
Experience the intense combat of [TOUGEN ANKI Crimson Inferno] through the cinematic first look of the upcoming game. 

📌 September 25th - September 28th, 2025 | Tokyo Game Show


About TOUGEN ANKI
"Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood", written by Yura Urushibara, is a popular series currently serialized in AKITASHOTEN’s Weekly Shōnen Champion. Based on the well-known Japanese folktale Momotaro, the story depicts the conflict between those who inherit the blood of Oni (demons) and Momotaro. With over 4 million copies in circulation, the Tougen Anki Project was launched in June 2023. The first installment was a stage play adaptation, the second installment a TV anime adaptation, and the third installment a smart phone game adaptation.
